info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Interviews-v3-spec
info.description: The Interview Scheduling API allows organizations to retrieve a list of scheduled interviews for career applications. This endpoint is designed for HR teams and recruiters to manage the interview process efficiently. Users can access detailed information about each interview, including applicant details, interview timing, and interviewer assignment. It supports use cases where tracking interview schedules and applicant progress is essential, ensuring a streamlined hiring workflow.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of applications related to interviews. It is designed to help users access detailed information about the interview applications they have submitted or those available for their review.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving interview application details. Please provide the necessary parameters to filter or specify your request when sending JSON data.

201.description: Successfully retrieved a list of interview applications.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to applications and interviews.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the application reference.

resultId.description: Identifier for the specific result of the application processing.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message providing context to the result of the operation.

audit.description: Audit information pertaining to the application processing.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRespons.description: Response schema for the GET operation of the interview applications API, indicating the status and details of the processed application.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application processing was automated.

Audit.description: Audit information related to the application process, including who created it and when.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be used for performance monitoring and optimization.
